title: 高考高频词 · 满分作文模板手册

sections.name: 应用文模板 · 建议信

items.s: I'm delighted to hear that you are coming to China. As for your questions, I'd like to offer some practical suggestions.
items.c: 很高兴听说你要来中国。关于你的问题，我想提供一些实用建议。

items.s: First and foremost, it is advisable to book tickets in advance, for the summer vacation is a peak travel season.
items.c: 首先，建议提前订票，因为暑假是出行高峰期。

items.s: In addition, visiting the museum is well worth your time, where you can gain a deeper insight into Chinese history.
items.c: 此外，参观博物馆非常值得，在那里你能更深入地了解中国历史。

items.s: Last but not least, remember to try some local snacks, which will surely be a feast for your taste buds.
items.c: 最后但同样重要的是，记得尝尝当地小吃，一定会让你的味蕾大饱口福。

items.s: I hope these suggestions will be of great help to you. Looking forward to your arrival!
items.c: 希望这些建议对你有帮助。期待你的到来！

sections.name: 应用文模板 · 邀请信

items.s: On behalf of the Student Union, I am writing to sincerely invite you to attend our Chinese Paper-cutting Exhibition.
items.c: 我谨代表学生会，诚挚邀请您参加我们的中国剪纸展。

items.s: The exhibition is scheduled to be held in the school hall from 3:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. on June 8th.
items.c: 展览定于 6 月 8 日下午 3 点至 5 点在学校礼堂举行。

items.s: It is a golden opportunity to appreciate the beauty of traditional Chinese art and communicate with talented students.
items.c: 这是欣赏中国传统艺术之美、与才华横溢的同学们交流的绝佳机会。

items.s: We would feel much honored if you could deliver a brief speech on the development of folk art.
items.c: 如果您能就民间艺术的发展做简短发言，我们将深感荣幸。

items.s: Your presence will add color to our activity. We are looking forward to your reply at your earliest convenience.
items.c: 您的到来将为我们的活动增光添彩。期待您尽早回复。

sections.name: 读后续写 · 动作描写高频表达

items.s: She took a deep breath and summoned up her courage to move forward.
items.c: 她深吸一口气，鼓起勇气向前走去。

items.s: His eyes widened in disbelief as he stared at the scene before him.
items.c: 他难以置信地瞪大眼睛，盯着眼前的景象。

items.s: With tears welling up in her eyes, she whispered a word of thanks.
items.c: 她热泪盈眶，低声道了声谢。

items.s: He hesitated for a moment, his mind racing to find a way out.
items.c: 他犹豫了一下，脑子里飞快地想着出路。

items.s: A warm current surged through her heart, sweeping away all her fears.
items.c: 一股暖流涌上她的心头，驱散了所有的恐惧。

items.s: Hardly had he opened the door when a burst of laughter greeted him.
items.c: 他刚打开门，就迎来了一阵笑声。（Hardly...when 倒装加分句）

items.s: The moment she saw the familiar figure, all her anxiety melted away.
items.c: 一看到那个熟悉的身影，她的焦虑便烟消云散。

items.s: Exhausted as he was, a sense of achievement washed over him.
items.c: 尽管疲惫不堪，一种成就感仍涌遍他的全身。（as 让步倒装）

items.s: Clutching the letter tightly, she hurried home through the pouring rain.
items.c: 她紧紧攥着信，冒着倾盆大雨匆匆往家赶。

items.s: What happened next was totally beyond my expectation.
items.c: 接下来发生的事完全出乎我的意料。

sections.name: 情绪与氛围 · 高分描写句式

items.s: Joy and pride welled up inside me, and I couldn't resist smiling.
items.c: 喜悦和自豪从我心底涌起，我忍不住笑了。

items.s: The sky was painted golden by the setting sun, casting a warm glow over the quiet village.
items.c: 夕阳把天空染成金色，为宁静的村庄洒下温暖的光辉。

items.s: A wave of relief swept over him when the result was announced.
items.c: 结果宣布时，一阵如释重负的感觉掠过他的心头。

items.s: To my surprise, what lay ahead was nothing but a vast expanse of grassland.
items.c: 令我惊讶的是，展现在眼前的只有一望无际的草原。

items.s: The atmosphere was filled with laughter and warmth, which I would treasure forever.
items.c: 空气中洋溢着笑声和温暖，我将永远珍藏这份记忆。

items.s: Standing on the top of the mountain, we were rewarded with a breathtaking view.
items.c: 站在山顶，壮丽的景色让我们不虚此行。

items.s: Never will I forget the encouraging smile on my teacher's face.
items.c: 我永远忘不了老师脸上鼓励的微笑。（Never 倒装）

items.s: It dawned on me that true friendship is one of life's most precious gifts.
items.c: 我恍然大悟：真挚的友谊是人生最珍贵的礼物之一。

sections.name: 主题升华 · 结尾万能句

items.s: This experience taught me a valuable lesson: where there is a will, there is a way.
items.c: 这段经历给我上了宝贵的一课：有志者事竟成。

items.s: Not only did the activity enrich my after-class life, but it also deepened my understanding of teamwork.
items.c: 这次活动不仅丰富了我的课余生活，还加深了我对团队合作的理解。（Not only 倒装）

items.s: From then on, I made up my mind to spread kindness to everyone around me.
items.c: 从那时起，我下定决心把善意传递给身边的每一个人。

items.s: As the saying goes, "Actions speak louder than words." I will practice what I have learned.
items.c: 俗话说：“行动胜于言辞。”我会践行所学。

items.s: Only by stepping out of our comfort zone can we discover a better self.
items.c: 只有走出舒适区，我们才能发现更好的自己。

items.s: It is through small acts of kindness that our world becomes a better place.
items.c: 正是通过点滴善举，我们的世界才变得更加美好。（It is...that 强调句）
